decision_authority: RSCH research judgment after ROLE_REVIEW_READY execution
earliest_execution: T+1; orders, fills and costs are not tested here
source_boundary: Existing-permission Tushare interfaces through DFLS and receipted predecessors only

components.name: 沪深300短期反向机会背景
components.availability: Completed T domestic index session, used at T20:30
components.missing_policy: Unavailable; do not substitute or infer a trading permission
supports: 1/3-day raw and partial ranking positive in all three review segments
Three-day fixed high-low label spread positive in each segment
Complementary to ETF tail rather than identical information
limitations: Latest-segment 1/3-day magnitude prediction worse than training mean
Latest one-day fixed-tail difference slightly negative
Rank/loss evidence is selected development evidence, not independent alpha
not_authorized_uses: Ten-day continuation or standalone buy rule

components.name: ETF尾盘90分钟回吐入场信息
components.source: DFLS etf.ohlcv 30m; Tushare; 159326.SZ; eight complete bars per session
components.availability: Completed T session and scheduled adjustment availability at17:00, used at T20:30
components.missing_policy: Unavailable on incomplete sessions; no substitution with 60-minute signal
supports: One/three-day rank and fixed-tail effects have the same direction in all review segments
Three-day price-persistence label supports short-lived path interpretation
Independent reconstruction from3408 minute bars agrees with the inherited matrix
limitations: Paired loss confidence interval crosses zero
Five/ten-day continuation and standalone risk-control roles are not established
Same-day ratio cancels common adjustment scale but historic bar revisions remain possible
not_authorized_uses: Substitution of forward path labels into trading rules

components.name: ETF五日平均振幅风险状态
components.formula: mean((HFQ_High-HFQ_Low)/HFQ_Close over completed sessions T-4 through T)
components.availability: Five completed daily sessions, scheduled adjustment availability at17:00, used at T20:30
components.missing_policy: Unavailable without all five observations; no zero fill
supports: Future range and adverse-price magnitude are positively related in all review segments
Each segment's standalone prediction improves on training-mean error for both risk labels
Paired risk-loss improvement90percent intervals remain positive
limitations: Historical fixed low-state bins are empty in later segments
Expanding linear models underpredict absolute risk in later periods
Future range association is not demonstrated avoided loss
Direction of expected return and exact position-sizing rule are not established
not_authorized_uses: Use of EX10 absolute quantile cutoffs as proven trading limits
Guaranteed drawdown reduction or calibrated risk limit

components.name: 已完成美股SPX单日风险偏好确认
components.formula: SPX decimal daily return on latest US source date strictly earlier than China T; missing if lag exceeds10 calendar days
components.source: DFLS index.global_daily; existing Tushare global-index permission; SPX
components.availability: Strictly earlier source date than China decision date, used at T20:30
components.missing_policy: Unavailable when source is absent or older than10 calendar days; no stale extension
supports: One-day rank, fixed-tail difference and conditional rank are positive in all three review segments
Low correlation with ETF tail and positive residual information after other primary fields
Price-persistence proportion provides secondary, weak corroboration
limitations: Primary one-day regression coefficient is negative in the first training window
Magnitude prediction is worse than the mean and the paired improvement interval is negative
EX10 one-day BH q is about0.109 and persistence q about0.159; neither establishes global significance
Discovery persistence association is weak, and longer-horizon discovery directions differ
Previous US session is deliberately delayed; no claim of using current US close
not_authorized_uses: Mandatory entry veto without stage-three testing

common_limits: All prior experiments, failed routes and same historical samples remain development-pool contamination
Historical supplier publication/revision vintages are not individually proven
Components are neither individually tradable strategies nor a validated profitable combination
No trade thresholds, exits, weights, transaction frequency, cost-adjusted performance or account goals have been validated
Entry and risk roles are sufficient research inputs for stage three; an additional independent hold/exit predictor is not a universal stage-two requirement

stage_three_readiness.basis: Distinct market opportunity, ETF entry, continuous risk context and optional external confirmation each have bounded role evidence; full component definitions and screening/adverse evidence are available
stage_three_readiness.next_action: Preregister one complete falsifiable strategy hypothesis before any prototype or account search
